content: npm 'psl' package parses a hostname into tld/sld/domain/subdomain using the Public Suffix List, giving accurate apex-vs-subdomain classification (e.g. store.example.co.uk -> apex example.co.uk). Lighter alternative 'get-apex-domain' skips the PSL entirely with a naive heuristic. Since Kurzly's UI-SPEC has the admin explicitly confirm/override type at creation (D-02), a simple label-count heuristic client-side is sufficient and avoids a new dependency.
